caption:
Felt a grab in the front of the thigh mid-sprint, like Toto?

Sprinting, kicking and sudden changes of pace ask the quads to lengthen and contract hard at once. For the first few days, walk within comfort, skip hard stretching into the pain, and park sprinting and kicking.

Once walking feels easier, light holds, bridges and partial squats can build strength gradually. Running builds from jogging to strides before full sprints, and kicking starts with short, light passes.

A pop with heavy bruising, a dent in the thigh or worsening pain is worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can plan your way back. Book online via the link in bio ⚽
